changeSet.author: nathp
changeSet.comment: Remove legacy deletedAt field from trace snapshots stored in feedback.associations JSON.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE feedback SET associations = jsonb_set( associations::jsonb, '{traces}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(trace_element - 'deletedAt') FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element ) ) WHERE associations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(associations::jsonb, 'traces') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element WHERE jsonb_exists(trace_element, 'deletedAt') );

rollback.comment: No rollback possible: deletedAt values are intentionally removed from historical JSON snapshots.
